author: AWPtic
text:
Hi everyone,
First of all I wanted to say that I use the mobile UG apps all the time and absolutely love them! It makes things so convenient! However, I feel like the forums (along with lessons and others) is a major part of what UG is and should be acknowledged on mobile devices just like tabs.
Anyone can access the website through their phone's internet browser, but it's just not convenient enough. Where on the other hand, tapping once on an app's icon and instantly viewing a clean organized page is a great relief due to saving a bunch of steps (type address, zoom in, click link, zoom in again, etc). The UG Tabs and Tab Pro apps are great examples of this.
Also, with our constantly progressing society, simplicity to perform actions has become expected. I know there has been times in your life where you have wondered why someone has not created an easier way to do something. I personally search for applications whenever I'm wanting to try something new or just plain out curious.
Finally, becoming mobile brings in a whole new population of people, along with the majority of current users. Thus, this would increase the number of daily UG users and would make the Ultimate-Guitar name bigger. Now, I know that there is probably not a way to connect the actual website forums to the application, but no worries, because with the new users coming in there will be plenty of people to fill the forums app up nice and fast.
I hope that you take my proposal into consideration, because I know that myself and others would love to partake in the UG forums wherever we may be.
PS: Another option would be to upgrade vBulletin to version 5 and enable it on the ForumRunner app. However, I would advise against this since ForumRunner often receives bad reviews which could send angry users your way. Also, UG would not receive any money from it, practically no one would know that UG had mobile forums, and the icon wouldn't be all pretty with the UG logo on it. Also, I heard that ForumRunner is not all that "touch-touch-you're-there" simple.

I purchased the Pageflip Dragonfly 4 button bluetooth pedal to easily scroll up and down within a tab using the larger buttons and also progress through the tabs within the playlist with the other two buttons.

author: mikxe6
text: Why can’t users make personal edits to “official“ versions? If the edits are for personal use and nobody else sees them, what’s the harm? I like to place half-measures inside parentheses, double chord letters if they correspond to two measures, place chord letters above correct lyrics, etc. The fact that I can’t do this to “official” versions, which often look better than other versions, makes them largely useless to me.

author: metelev.vladislav.ug
text:
mikxe6
A lot of other sites just download Pro files availiable at UG and use them without any attribution to UG and/or authors who created the file.
Official tabs are created by UG Team only and as you mentioned they are more likely to have a better quality. However, quality takes time to create. So we just don't want for our Official tabs to be easily found on other sites or the whole team work and effort just wouldn't worth it. And as a result UG users would have less opportunities to get the high quality content.
I guess this is a trade-off we have to make.

author: mikxe6
text:
metelev.vladislav.ug
metelev.vladislav.ug
Thanks for clarifying. I see your point. Unfortunately, beginners can’t play these official tabs (or any, for that matter) right out of the box, so to speak. I imagine an expert can read E D A E above the lyrics, for example, and somehow understand that the first E is actually two measures of E, and the last E is a half measure. But it’s not obvious to beginners. We would benefit from seeing E E and (E), in this example. I’m able to accomplish this notation on my own by cross referencing a UG tab with Chordify, then editing a non-official tab. But, as we seem to agree, the UG official versions are superior.  Since you don’t give me all the notation I require to play them, and since I can’t edit them for my own private use (even though I’m paying for your app), the official versions are useless to me, and others with less than expert musical skills.  Meantime, a minority of customers (experts) find them useful, and UG official tabs are protected from potential piracy.  I suggest UG look for ways to better accommodate a broader base of paying customers, and attracting more, rather than catering to a minority of users and worrying about getting ripped off.

author: metelev.vladislav.ug
text:
mikxe6
I see your point. However, this is not something that would help to solve a beiginner's pain.
We've been thinking about what you've said for quite a time now and the better solution which accounts for chord play duration is needed here. And I must say it's not easy to make such a turn around within a short period of time. So let's see what comes next.
Thank you for your feedback.

author: UG Support
text:
Quote by bsix11242
I have installed Tabs, Tabs HD and Tabs Pro HD.  I installed all 3 progressively thinking as I went along I was getting the earlier versions feature set plus more.  it appears that Tabs HD and Tabs Pro HD are very similar (yet still different) and Tabs has features the other two don't.  So why 3 versions and why doesn't Tabs Pro HD have all the features of the other two with the same search library?
Ultimate Guitar Tabs HD and Tab Pro HD are two different apps: UGT HD contains world’s largest catalog of chords, guitar and bass tabs in text format (more than 400,000 tabs and chords) while Tab Pro HD gives access to Tab Pro tabs in interactive format (similar to Guitar Pro and Power Tabs)- more than 200,000 tabs. Ultimate Guitar Tabs for iPhone is similar to UGT HD but has been developed separately for iPhone (can also be used on iPad)

author: musicforte
text:
I submitted my first chord chart recently and it was rejected.  I found this to be very disappointing.
I aligned it well.  It does not already exist in the archives as a chord chart, it was the complete song, and it was accurate.  I say this confidently holding a degree in Jazz piano performance.
My point is...
There are way too many charts submitted that have errors.  I thought if I could submit my own, I would chart the songs correctly and have them all in one place for myself and others who may have appreciated them.
It doesn't appear that will be possible.
So here is my idea of a solution...
Allow those of us with upgraded accounts to make corrections.  Those corrections would not have to be shared with the entire community.  They could be stored in a corrections database that is matched with our user id.
This would allow anyone with an upgraded account to have the music exactly as they need it, and not have to waste time submitting a correct version (or a version that pertains to their needs) just to see it rejected.
I think this would make the mobile app incredibly useful.
What do you think?

author: NotAtWork
text:
I'm starting a new thread on this, because we have been waiting MANY MONTHS for a this serious issue to be addressed.
If a tab is edited on another device or using the web site on a desktop browser, it is rarely updated (refreshed) in the iOS app. The only workaround at present it to logout and log back in which will redownload all playlists and favorite tabs (include personal tabs). As an actively gigging musician, redownloading takes quite some time (bad) and the logout/login loses important information (like scroll speed and display zoom on a tab).
Until this issue can be properly addressed, the most expedient way to allow a user to obtain the latest tab version would be to add a "Force Download' operation on any tab. I saw in another thread where someone else had this issue of a new iPad not getting subscription restore to work where you advised them to first create a login account on their old iPad and get the subscription somehow associated with their account on your web site and that this would then allow the restore of the in-app purchase on their new iPad.

I'm hereby requesting you either restore my lifetime subscription to the app, or I will push this matter further with Apple over your violation of the AppStore agreement. https://developer.apple.com/library/ios/documentation/NetworkingInternet/Conceptual/StoreKitGuide/Chapters/Restoring.html#//apple_ref/doc/uid/TP40008267-CH8-SW9

author: canonli
text:
Update - now it's working 😃
The IRig Blueturn has 3 different mode configurations – Arrow up/down, Page up/down or Arrow left/right. I used mode 2 when I was trying to connect in the UG app. I did use mode 2 due to my needs of scrolling up and down.
After some frustrating hours of troubleshooting I discovered the solution:
Mode 1 is the BT-105 mode for the iRig Blueturn (!)
I changed to mode 1 and, selected my device is a BT-105, then I managed to set up the scrolling up and down with my pedal.
Now the iRig Blueturn pedal is working just fine 👌

(thanks
UG Team
), but has introduced a new bug: opening playlists no longer works. It returns to the start screen, and a second attempt yeilds a blank screen.
I’ve been a pro subscriber for several years, and have seen this sort of thing happen many times. One bug gets fixed or a feature added, and another bug gets introduced that breaks important functionality. In software engineering this is referred to as a regression. There is an easy solution to it:
UG Support
could you please encourage the developmers to do more regression testing before releases? There are automated frameworks for doing this which would certainly catch these sort of bugs before release.
I have reported this bug to ultimate guitar support via the app’s contact support function, and encourage you to do so too if you’re affected.
Thanks,
Graham

author: mayiv
text:
First of all, I am happy with playing tabs with Android standalone TabPro.
The only thing I miss is a kind of transposing of tuning.
You know, many bands use standard (or drop D) tuning, but moved down a halftone or more. I really don't want to retune my guitar, but still would like to play along the bassline.
What I imagine is a setting, where I set my guitar's tuning.
Then, a configurable option to transpose/not transpose all the _sounds_ except drums (not the tab itself). For simplicity, it could work e.g. only when all guitar tracks are in the same tuning.
OK, maybe it's not very clear. An example:
I have E standard guitar tuning (ebgdae):
I would like to play
Dream Theater - Forsaken
which is
Tuning: D Standard (D,G,C,F,A,D)
First guitar notes are:
D -
A -
F  -
C 7
G 5
D -
I would like it to be still displayed
-
-
-
7
5
-
But played as if it was
D -
A -
F -
C 9
G 7
D -
or for my guitar tuning
E -
B -
G -
D 7
A 5
E -
I just don't care for correct key while learning to play a song. I only want sounds of other instruments to be matched and play exactly what is written.
Of course if the song is written for non-matching kind of tuning (e.g. standard E, but guitar is set to drop D) the app should not transpose sounds at all.

.

author: UG Support
text:
bulastoner
if UG app doesn't have an update available in the Google Play Store, it likely means the update is not yet available in your region. You can try a few things, such as checking for updates to the Play Store itself, clearing the store's cache and data, or ensuring your device's date and time are correct. If the issue persists, it could be a compatibility issue with your device or region. Here's a more detailed breakdown:
Confirm the App is Available in Your Region:
Sometimes, UG app updates are rolled out in phases or are not available in all regions.
Check if the UG app is actually available in your country by searching for it in the Play Store or on the developer's website.
Check for Play Store Updates:
Open the Play Store app and tap your profile icon, then go to "Settings" -> "About" -> "Update Play Store".
If an update is available, it will download and install automatically.
Clear Play Store Cache and Data:
Go to your device's Settings -> Apps -> See all apps -> Google Play Store -> Storage & cache.
Tap "Clear cache" and "Clear data".
Check Date and Time Settings:
Ensure your device's date, time, and time zone are set correctly, either manually or automatically.
Check for System Updates:
Go to Settings -> System -> System update (or similar, depending on your device) to check for and install any available OS updates.
Reinstall Google Play Store Updates:
Follow the instructions in point 2 to access the Play Store's "About" section.
Tap on "Update Play Store" to reinstall the updates.
Verify Device and UG App Compatibility:
Make sure your device meets the minimum requirements for the app.
Check if the app is compatible with your Android version.

author: UG Support
text:
Hi guys! Yes, there is a bug with 1st gen iPads. Cause is the app gets some data from server during first launch after installation or uploading from multitasking. If thetre is some problem with internet connection on iPad, app can't wait for the end of server session and crashes.
Try to do following steps:
1. Change internet connection (e.g. try to use stable Wi-Fi) and restart the app again.
2. Fully switch off internet connection on your iPad, open the app and then switch on your internet again.
3. Go to Settings > Reset >  Reset network settings.
The last is one our user's advice, I didn't test it, but maybe it helps you.
Anyway we will fix this bug in future update, please be patient.
PS. Please indicate here, what certain step helped you. Or nothing helps.

author: allandstewart
text:
Hi,
The main issue for me is I try to compact chords as much as possible because we mostly sing songs on a small phone screen and can't be scrolling up/down in the middle of strumming and singing a song. This is an important practical point I hope can be brought to the attention of the UG team.
In the early days it was obvious when one row of chords would be the same for the following lines, say, within a chorus or a verse. I prefer to have chords above most lines, except where it is obviously repeated:
"E                       E B A
"we're the planeteers, you can be one too!"
"cuz saving our planet is the thing to do!"
"looting and polluting is not the way!"
"hear what captain planet has to say!"
What I avoid doing is having all the chords in one verse and then omitting the chords in a 2nd verse. I see many users used to do that and those chords have
still not been corrected, which is also frustrating for having to scroll up and down. The key, for this app to be most practical and effective, is to strike a balance between too many and too few chords - ultimately to reduce the need to scroll up and down; make sure each verse/chorus/bridge has chords on the top line, i.e. don't exclude chords from any verse/chorus, but allow for the choice to decide whether or not chords are needed in the 2nd & 3rd lines, etc., i.e. if each line in a verse/chorus has the same chord progression.
Does this make sense to you guys? Do the UG tech facilitators even play guitar themselves? At the end of the day, even if you disagree with my method, I am a user who benefits from my method. The likelihood of people using my chords is low, because they're not very commonly sung songs. I would appreciate if my contributions could be approved according to my preferences. UG app is the best way for me to look at chords while playing a song, because the screen doesn't black out. I need to be able to play flowingly according to my own pace - which is why I also don't use the auto-scroll option
Cheers,
Allan

author: UG Support
text:
Quote by alvarezjuan9
Hello, I have all my favorites on the ipad version and I cant find the synch option to upload those favorites to the website account. Help is greatly appreciated.
Just use your UG account:
In order to synchronize tabs in the Favorites section of the app with your Ultimate Guitar account, you need to go through the following steps:
- Go to the "Home" screen of your Ultimate Guitar Tabs app on your device.
- Go to "Account".
- "Sign In" with your Ultimate-Guitar.com account.
- When asked "Do you want to synchronize Favorites with your website account?", choose "OK" (Wait until the process is fully completed).
Note: If you already have Favorites on your device, the app will ask you to keep them (choose "Synchronize" to keep everything you have in your Favorites).
The synchronization button will appear in your Favorites after this procedure. Use it for syncing tabs anytime in the future.
Now you can sync your Favs using UG account on any device.
Note: it's technically impossible to sync Playlists, only full Favorites content. Also it's impossible to sync tab pro files.

author: UG Support
text:
Hey, Thom.
I tried to contact the support on numerous occasions about different issues and never had any answer. It sucks.
Actually that's not true, man
I've just checked your correspondence with one of the supporters in Jan/Feb 2016.
Thank you for your feedback concerning the search feature. It's really valuable to us and I will transfer it to our iOS developers. Also Zappp has seen it!
Now when you type your search you can choose between songs and artists.
Just choose artist and you'll get all results for this band. I personally find  the new search pretty handy. But still it's the matter of taste and habit. I see that you've been with us pretty long now... so maybe you need time to get used to the new search?
We are also very grateful for your tabs' submissions to Ultimate Gutiar. We've been recently working on the new editing rules and guidelines for contributors and actually
are
still working on the improvements.
You can check the latest version of the guideline here --->
https://www.ultimate-guitar.com/contribution/help/rubric
I've referred your concerns about your tabs being
edited by UG editing team
to... (surprise!) the UG Editing Team
It's their job to smooth out some bits of tabs that you guys submit. We understand that your personal style of Tab Author is important but we really believe that there should be some general rules. Otherwise it'll become an unorganized anarchy.
So the UG editing team are now discovering the right way to maintain balance and save both the Author's unique style and compliance with the rules.
Next time when you're about to submit a tab to UG, please check out the latest version of the guideline and make sure that you've made it a bit easier for the editing team to approve your tab without any editing
Anyway, huge thanks for your contribution to Ultimate Gutiar.

text: Here’s a trick that worked for me that doesn’t delete all your settings. author: tigermetal
text:
Shzzilla
thanks for the feedback! Yeah, the feature seems obvious, it's just some technical limitations that prevent us from doing this. Will include this in our future plans and hope to make it one day.
For now, there is a small hack that allows you to add your Workshop presets to a pedalboard — just open the list of recently opened presets (tap Search) and swipe any of the presets to see options. There is an option to add preset to a pedalboard, even for Workshop ones. This doesn't upload the preset to our server, and it won't save it for too long due to that (once you open another pedalboard, all Workshop presets will disappear from all the pedalboards), but it's still worth trying.

author: tigermetal
text:
Hi
streubie
, Tonebridge designer here.
If the demo samples/YouTube/Spotify sound OK with the setup, then the problem might be in how you connect your guitar to the iRig.
Be sure that:
(1) the volume knob on your guitar is set to max,
(2) the tone knob is also on max (the guitar should sound brighter),
(3) the strings on the guitar are not too old (they should not sound muddy),
(4) the guitar is connected to the guitar port on the iRig and not the amp port (as obvious as it is),
(5) the volume on your iRig is set to just below the max (don't set it to max to avoid sound clipping),
(6) the THRU/FX switch on the iRig is set to pass the sound to the iPhone (can't remember the needed position, so try to play around with the switch to find it)
Please let me know if this helps — will try something else in case it doesn't work. Cheers!

The Now Playing option searches tabs for song which is currently playing by device's Media Player. To activate this option you should launch some track in Media Player and open the app on the home page. By pressing this button matching tabs list will appear. author: superweh
text:
Hi,
I've paid for a subscription for the iPad Tabs HD app, but it doesn't work.... I still get the message "subscription required".
What do I do?

author: UG Support
text:
Light variant:
Restart your iPad, update your app to the newest version and then restore your subs. To restore your subscription you should tap "Subscribe now" button in the app's main menu. Then, tap the "Restore" button and enter the same Apple ID, that was used for purchase.
Please note that your Apple ID password is not the same as your email password. If you don't remember the password for your Apple ID, please use the Forgot Password option.
Hard variant (the Light doesn't help):
1. Restart your device.
2. Create account or use your old account to sync your Favorites with ultimate-guitar.com and save them. After this delete Tabs HD app from your iPad.
3. Go to Settings > General > Date & Time > check a date, it has to be actual.
4. Go to Settings -> iTunes & App Store -> delete (sign out) your Apple ID.
5. Go to App Store app -> download Tabs HD app, using the same Apple ID, that was used for purchase.
6. Open Tabs HD, tap "Subscribe now" button in the app's main menu. Then, tap the "Restore my subscription" button and enter the same Apple ID, that was used for purchase.
Still can't restore? Welcome to our Support:
https://www.ultimate-guitar.com/about/contact.htm

author: Electromus
text:
It only makes sense that I would use UG as my on stage lyrics and chords backup, since I learn and practice most of  my songs on UG. I have a nifty little clasp that hooks on my mic stand and do just that...
But it doesn't feel like its built to do that for several reasons, and it just makes sense to make some changes to make it better and easier.
When most people are using this on stage, I am willing to bet they are using an instrument most of the time, meaning their hands can't be used but for a fraction of a second due to needing to play the music. For this reason, their should be a gig mode on the app. If not a gig mode, than a separate app called a gig companion.
In this mode, it should
1. Automatically update my edits to my playlist. Its a pain in the butt to have to replace each tab I am editing to optimize for auto scrolling or personal chord choices, bpm etc in my playlist. Making a single master personal edit that automatically asks me if I want to replace the tab I am editing in this playlist, and even offer me which other playlists I want to replace the tab. Most musicians aren't trying to be tab contributers and don't want to go through the process for every single song of (in my case) 30 to 40 songs.
2. there should be a tempo light option that is stationary while everything else is scrolling, and even give me an option to hear it, as I could use my blue tooth earbud if I wanted to play along with a click, (please give multiple click sound options) that is automatically configured to the BPM I choose and enter for THAT song.
3. At the beginning of the song, when I hit start, it would be nice to have a note available to pop up where I can be reminded of things for that song, such as, turn up the reverb on the amp, the bass down on your guitar etc, for song specific changes that need to quickly be made. It could also have a tempo tapper option for those people who don't want to be locked into one tempo every time the play it. Call it tempo dynamic artist choices if you will. Sometimes I want to really slow a song down for the mood.
4. I should be able to swipe left and right for changing tabs in the order of my playlist.
5. Speaking of order, changing order in the playlist is super glitchy, with it being necessary for me to go out of the playlist and back in for it to operate smoothly in my latest version of android.
6. For auto scrolling, I have seen others complain about the speed options, and my answer to them, is to resize your tab by pinching motions. This helps me alot, as if the words are a little smaller, than it can scroll faster. But that aside, it really would be nice to have more options in scroll speed. AND FOR THIS CONTEXT (of this thread I am writing) again
TAPPING for scroll speed in gig mode, or gig companion is CRITICAL. That is the BIGGEST pain in the ass, when something is wrong with my speed or position in the song while playing it and I have to change it in the middle of the song, especially for songs that I tend to mess up the lyrics on. (im getting old guys, I can't remember all the lyrics anymore, give me a break)
Split the tapping zones in two portions, upper and lower HALF of the screen. Give me a big area to hit, remember, I am playing guitar, singing and entertaining, I need to quickly reach up and tap to change the location of the tab or speed of the scroll.
Single tap should bring me up one half page. make it so you have to pause between doing it again so it doesn't confuse with double tap, because double tap should change the scroll speed.
Every. single. Gig. I have issues with scroll speed. its a great thing to have, and I still use it, but it needs to be optimized for reliability and ease of use.
PS, in a corner you could at a zone for tempo tapping to adjust tempo while playing, though I think having it at the beginning of the song would suffice.
Im sure there are other things that could be done, but this would be awesome.
PS.
If you do these things and it was a good idea, Ill always take some free gear
